comments.body:
Phase 1 RCA — confirmed defect (no repair performed)

Proven root cause
`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pin_health.py:125-180` derives related-material health by computing only the latest fingerprint and classifying every unequal pin as `stale-pin-drift` at lines 165-166. Its public delegation in `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:50-61` supplies only `current_material_fingerprint`. This omits the full-hash compatibility already applied to the reviewed ticket itself by `_legacy_material_ok` at `attest.py:593-670`, which recognizes both superseded fingerprint generations while still rejecting real edits. Consequently, an unchanged prerequisite pinned under the post-330c/pre-2be7 generation is falsely marked drifted after commit `1afdbbd0be` changed insignificant-whitespace normalization.

Discriminating runtime proof
Using the retired attestation pin for canonical prerequisite `ae96-f114-5363-4d57` (`6b113a084820af9d`), a `sys.settrace` execution of `attest.derive_plan_material_pin_health(..., enforced=True)` observed `pin_health.derive_health` compute latest `current=bbe91c054a677441` and take the line-165 inequality branch, returning aggregate and target `stale-pin-drift`. Recomputing the SAME current ticket state yielded pre-330c `d39605b03b9a7f3e` and post-330c/pre-2be7 `6b113a084820af9d`; `_legacy_material_ok` returned true. Thus the historical pin exactly matches a supported full fingerprint generation for the resolved target. A negative valid-hex control pin `0000000000000000` returned `_legacy_material_ok=false` and remained `stale-pin-drift`.

Rivals rejected
The prerequisite last event is `1786100248773305001-...-SIGNATURE.json`; the dependent review was signed at `1786115382183702000`, about 4.2 hours later, with no intervening or later prerequisite event. This rejects hidden/repaired state mutation and genuine event drift. Canonical ID `ae96-f114-5363-4d57` was carried through the runtime call and produced the exact historical-generation hash, rejecting wrong target resolution. The false status is therefore fingerprint-generation drift, not plan-material drift.

Defect legitimacy
Classification: `defect`. Authority `jira-reb-1160` says related pins invalidate after related plan-material drift, while unchanged material is the causal boundary. `convulsive-calx-yearling` explicitly requires failed-sign recovery to succeed when own and review-time related material remain current. `ethnogenic-forbidden-umbrette` independently requires positively detected genuine dependency drift/loss to invalidate unconditionally. Full-hash compatibility satisfies both contracts: accept a supported historical generation only when its recomputation from CURRENT material matches byte-for-byte; otherwise remain stale.

Caller-dependency gate
Expected post-fix behavior: a pin matching the latest or any supported historical full-fingerprint generation of the current related ticket is `current`; a pin matching none remains `stale-pin-drift`; missing and malformed behavior is unchanged. Bounded sweep: `derive_health` has one production wrapper (`attest.py:50-61`), used by `compute_validity` (`attest.py:414`) and re-sign (`resign.py:261`). Their next-level consumers are claim/close/reuse/drift-refresh/bugfix-size gates plus audit/detail renderers. These are incidental consumers of the health contract: accepting unchanged material is required, and all still reject a genuine unmatched hash. No behavioral dependency on the false generation-drift result was found. Direct own-material users of `current_material_fingerprint` are outside the changed behavior and already use the legacy guard where attestation validity requires it.

Frozen RED contract card
```yaml
authoritative_contract: "Related pins invalidate only after actual related plan-material drift (jira-reb-1160); recovery succeeds when review-time related material remains current (convulsive-calx-yearling); a genuine dependency edit always invalidates (ethnogenic-forbidden-umbrette)."
trigger_preconditions: "In an ephemeral real ticket store, create a readable canonical related ticket whose latest fingerprint differs from its post-330c/pre-2be7 recomputation; construct a PlanMaterialPin from that historical recomputation without changing the ticket afterward. Prove latest != pinned and historical recomputation == pinned before exercising health."
production_path: "In-process unit through attest.derive_plan_material_pin_health, real pin_health.derive_health, and real current_material_fingerprint_impl against the ephemeral store. One tier lower with a stub fingerprint is insufficient because it cannot exercise the generation-compatibility seam."
test_tier: "In-process unit test, parameterized for supported historical full-fingerprint generations where fixtures permit."
observable_postcondition: "The unchanged historical-generation pin yields target and aggregate pin_status=current under enforcement; after a semantic material edit, the same pin yields target and aggregate pin_status=stale-pin-drift."
negative_control: "Semantically edit the ephemeral related ticket so its latest and every supported historical recomputation differ from the signed pin; assert stale-pin-drift. Also retain malformed/missing cases unchanged."
ci_gate: "Exact pytest node collected and executed without skip/xfail under the focused plan-material-pin unit suite, then the repository make test gate."
```
Existing coverage inventory: `tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health.py` proves latest-generation current and legacy-unpinned behavior; `tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py` proves ordinary unmatched drift, enforcement/advisory behavior, missing targets, and compute-validity propagation. Neither covers a valid pin from a superseded fingerprint generation, so the RED oracle should strengthen this health suite rather than duplicate a higher-level claim fixture.

Phase boundary
Phase 1 Stages 2-3 are complete. No production or test files were edited, no RED test was created or run, and Phase 2 was not entered.

comments.body:
Final rebar-debug report (ticket intentionally left in_progress; closure deferred)

Problem: an unchanged prerequisite pinned under a supported historical fingerprint generation was rejected as stale material drift.

Proven root cause: pin_health.derive_health compared the signed related pin only with the latest fingerprint generation. The attestation wrapper did not supply the existing _legacy_material_ok recomputation used for own-ticket attestations, so algorithm evolution alone took the stale-pin-drift branch.

Proof: runtime tracing of the real retired pin observed signed 6b113a084820af9d versus latest bbe91c054a677441, with no prerequisite event after review; recomputation of current material under the supported intermediate generation exactly matched the signed pin. Wrong-target, hidden-event, semantic-edit, and arbitrary-hash alternatives were rejected.

Test: tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_generation_3e0f.py was observed RED before repair only for the unchanged historical-generation case (1 failed/2 controls passed), held out from the fixer, then GREEN 3/3. Removing the compatibility predicate returned exactly that case to RED while semantic-edit and unmatched-hash controls stayed green; restoring it returned GREEN. Focused pin/attestation suite passed 64/64.

Fix: derive_health accepts an optional fail-closed compatibility predicate after latest-hash mismatch; the public attestation wrapper supplies _legacy_material_ok. A pin becomes current only if a supported historical recomputation of current material exactly matches it. Latest current_fingerprint reporting and the original pinned_fingerprint are preserved.

Scope/safety: all production callers route through the attestation wrapper; compute_validity, resign, claim/close/reuse/drift consumers are incidental and still reject genuine unmatched drift. The fix restores jira-reb-1160 intent, adds no dependency, weakens no test, and fails stale on compatibility exceptions. make lint/typecheck passed.

Siblings/parity: own-ticket validity already used the same supported-generation rule; related-pin health was the only missing parallel surface. No other direct derive_health production wrapper or historical-generation comparison was found.

Replication: the original real-store scenario now yields aggregate/target current; semantic edit and 0000000000000000 remain stale-pin-drift. The report no longer reproduces.

Landing: Gerrit change 1564 received LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, had no unresolved comments, and was submitted/merged at 2026-08-09 18:51:48Z. No residual fragility observed beyond the fixed parity gap.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

A related-material pin can be rejected as stale solely because the fingerprint algorithm changed, even though the related ticket's material did not. Historical pin 6b113a084820af9d exactly matches the post-330c/pre-2be7 recomputation of the current prerequisite, while the latest generation yields bbe91c054a677441.

## Proven root cause

`pin_health.derive_health` compares pins only with the latest fingerprint. The plan-review wrapper supplies no compatibility check, although `attest._legacy_material_ok` already recognizes both supported historical full-hash generations for the subject's own material. The prerequisite had no post-review events; wrong-target and genuine-material-drift rivals were rejected. An unmatched hash control remains stale.

Original epic `jira-reb-1160` defines actual related-material drift as the invalidation boundary. Story `convulsive-calx-yearling` requires recovery when review-time related material remains current. `ethnogenic-forbidden-umbrette` requires genuine dependency edits to invalidate unconditionally.

## Repair plan

- Extend related-pin health with a narrowly scoped compatibility predicate supplied by the attestation layer.
- Classify a mismatched latest fingerprint as current only when recomputing the current related ticket under a supported historical full-fingerprint generation exactly matches the signed pin.
- Preserve current-fingerprint reporting, malformed/missing classifications, enforcement semantics, and genuine unmatched drift.
- Add a held-out ephemeral-store unit oracle at the real attestation-to-pin-health seam.

## Testing

- Run `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_generation_3e0f.py tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health.py tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_health_heldout.py`.
- Run `make lint` and `make typecheck`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] An unchanged related ticket pinned with the post-330c/pre-2be7 fingerprint is classified current, checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_generation_3e0f.py`.
- [x] A semantic edit makes that same historical pin stale, checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_generation_3e0f.py`.
- [x] An arbitrary unmatched valid hash remains stale, checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_material_pin_generation_3e0f.py`.
- [x] Latest-generation, malformed, missing, advisory, and enforced health behavior remains compatible, checked by the focused pin-health suite.
- [x] The held-out oracle is RED before the fix, GREEN after the fix, and RED again when historical compatibility is removed.
